title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：teapot　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 teapot 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the baker ① filled the teapot that no customer in the bakery would have counted, and he said the filling was the whole of the week. The ② teapot, meaning the pot itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a teapot, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ teapot in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ teapot at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A teapot, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the baker said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the teapot was the whole of the matter, meaning the hospitality and not the pot. The ⑥ teapot, meaning the hospitality and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; teapot, he said, is either something you fill or the only word that means both a pot and a hospitality. He said the hospitality is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ teapot had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ teapot of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of counting; teapot, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ teapot I remember is the pot counted in the bill, which closed in 1992 and is still counted as the quietest in the bakery. A ⑩ teapot, my mother said in 1994, is the only pot that improves by being counted; every teapot, she said, is a hospitality that has agreed to look like a pot. She said the hospitality was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 茶壶（指糕饼铺里每一把旁边的那一把）
B. n. 茶壶（指那把茶壶本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：fill the teapot 沏满这一把茶壶
D. n. 茶壶（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 茶壶之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的茶壶之事）
F. n. 茶壶（指账单里写到、被清点的那一把）
G. n. 茶壶、待客（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 待客（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: filled the teapot that no customer in the bakery would have counted
The teapot, meaning the pot itself and not the tray
the teapot at the far oven
the teapot was the whole of the matter
the teapot had become a line in a bill
The teapot of the whole thing
A teapot, my mother said in 1994

answers.why: fill the teapot 意为“沏满这一把茶壶”，1985 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯清点的一把茶壶做了一遍。
teapot 意为“茶壶”，指那把茶壶本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
teapot 意为“茶壶”，指糕饼铺里每一把旁边的那一把，每一把旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
teapot 意为“茶壶”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
teapot 意为“茶壶、待客”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这把待客就是那件事的全部。
teapot 意为“待客”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那把茶壶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
teapot 意为“茶壶”，指账单里写到、被清点的那一把，到 1990 年这一把成了账单里的一行。
teapot 意为“茶壶之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的茶壶之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的清点。
teapot 意为“茶壶”，我记得的是账单里清点过的那一把，1992 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一把。
teapot 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，茶壶是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的茶壶。
